title: All Fonts Pack
author: Chequered Ink
summary: Over 1200 commercial OTF and TTF font styles by Chequered Ink in one 23 MB sorted ZIP. The page documents full commercial use for small businesses and names the archive on the product page.
engineNote: The page lists Chequered Ink All Fonts Pack Sorted.zip with OTF and TTF inside. No engine project was verified; install fonts manually.
licenseNote: The page states pay-once unlimited commercial use for qualifying small businesses and links separate license terms. The archive was not downloaded.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $190 crossed out to $19. No paid download was made.

curation.rationale: 1200+ named font styles in one sorted ZIP with 155 ratings at 5.0 and explicit commercial terms. Value is exceptional at 90% off $190; individual font files were not audited.

title: 1000+ Fantasy RPG Icons
author: finalbossblues
summary: 1000+ 16-bit fantasy RPG icons in full-colour and monochrome variants across item, weapon, armour, consumable, currency and resource groups. Two ZIPs are named, 4.7 MB and 4.1 MB, plus a quick_guide.png overview.
engineNote: The FORMATS section states the set includes multiple formats for use in different engines: larger full sheets arranged for RPG Maker (32x32 for VX/Ace, 24x24 for MV) and that the full sheets should also work in most other engines and software. PNG is named through the documented quick_guide.png. Slicing sheets into engine atlases is manual work.
licenseNote: In the product's own comment thread the author answers that commercial use is OK, edits are fine, there are no engine limitations and no credit is required, pointing to the gamedevmarket Pro licence wording that permits any use except direct redistribution. The author also notes the separate Degica release carries an RPG Maker-only licence; this itch.io product does not.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $6.00 crossed out to $3.60 with a 40% Off badge. The pay-once minimum is $3.60 USD; no paid file was acquired.

curation.rationale: The listing documents 1000+ icons in two colour variants across named item, weapon, armour, consumable, currency, resource and faction groups, in 8.8 MB of publisher-listed archives, at 4.8/5 across 30 ratings. Value is graded exceptional because $3.60 is far below the usual price for a documented icon set of this scope; the ZIPs themselves were not opened, so quality and completeness stay at 4/5.

title: Tiny Swords: Warfare
author: Pixel Frog
summary: Combat expansion for Tiny Swords: warriors with their own weapons, animations and fighting styles in 5 unit colours, plus siege weapons, military buildings and fortifications. PNG images with Aseprite files, one 2.9 MB ZIP.
engineNote: No engine project is named on the page; it documents PNG images plus Aseprite source files, so atlas slicing and import settings are manual work in Unity, Godot, GameMaker or any 2D engine.
licenseNote: The page states 'Feel free to use this asset pack in both personal and commercial projects, modifying the assets as needed', crediting not required but welcome, and 'You may not redistribute, resell, or repackage the assets, even if the files are modified'. No paid download was made.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $30.00 crossed out to $15.00; the structured Offer price is 15 USD. No paid download was made.

curation.rationale: Pixel Frog's documented combat set - multiple warrior types with per-unit animations in 5 faction colours, siege weapons, military buildings and fortifications, PNG plus Aseprite source - is half the $30 list price at $15, which is far below the usual cost for a documented pack of this scope from this publisher. Completeness is graded 3 because the page marks the product 'In development' with content still on the roadmap, and the ZIP was not opened.

title: 2D Pixel Art Top-Down Character Template
author: ZeggyGames
summary: One 8-directional top-down character template with completed animation sets for walk, idle, run, sword attack, dash, mining, woodcutting, defence, parry, ranged attack and sword combo, sold as a single 486 kB ZIP.
engineNote: The page does not list the inner file formats or a named engine project; it is tagged 'Project template' and 'Isometric', so inspect the ZIP and set up pivots, sorting and sprite atlases in your engine manually.
licenseNote: The page states the asset may be used in unlimited projects including non-game projects, both free and commercial, may be modified at your discretion, may not be redistributed, resold or shared as modified versions, and may not be used to train AI/ML models. No paid download was made.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $7.50 crossed out to $4.95; the structured Offer price is 4.95 USD. No paid download was made.

curation.rationale: The listing documents a complete 8-directional state machine for one character - eleven named animation groups including mining, woodcutting, parry and a sword combo - at 4.9/5 across 75 ratings, and $4.95 is well below the usual price for a documented directional template of this scope. Completeness stays at 3 because it is a single character and the ZIP contents were not opened.
